newsitem.title: USA: Arrow Air inaugurates dedicated road feeder link.
newsitem.headline: Arrow Air inaugurates dedicated road feeder link.

text.p: Arrow Air has launched road feeder service connecting points in Texas, coastal Louisiana, Atlanta and Central Florida with its Miami flights to the Carbibbean and Latin America.
Arrow said the dedicated rigs carry conventional freight and also enable the carrier to extend its premier express service to the US destinations served by road.
The trucking operation is provided by AeroTruck, said Arrow.
Arrow said it has been awarded U.S. government authority to operate between Miami/Houston and Lima and Iquitos in Peru.

"The establishment of this road feeder service ... will enable us to inaugurate air service on the Texas route as quickly as market demand requires," said Ed Lesko, Arrow's vice president, domestic sales.
